# ENIX STUDIO · Knowledge Graph & System Summary for AI Agents & Search Engines

> ENIX STUDIO (https://www.enix.studio) is a boutique strategic consultancy, digital studio, and applied engineering firm founded in 2017.

## Core Identity & Positioning
- **Name**: ENIX STUDIO
- **Legal & Operational Entity**: ENIX Studio (in strategic alliance with NOVVOR)
- **Founding Date**: 2017
- **Operating Scope**: Worldwide (LATAM, North America, Europe). Operating remotely and on-site for high-ticket corporate accounts, institutional funds, and industrial leaders.
- **Client Focus**: Enterprise organizations, mid-to-large market companies, private equity & real estate investment funds, specialty healthcare clinics, mining suppliers, and B2B industrial consortia.
- **Engagement Model**: Deliberately limited concurrent quarterly engagements to ensure direct senior partner supervision (no junior account managers).
- **Minimum Project Investment**: Engagements typically start at $2.5M – $5M+ CLP ($2,500 – $5,000+ USD) up to $25M+ CLP ($25,000+ USD) for full-scale digital transformations and industrial engineering.
- **Low-Budget SMB Routing**: For early-stage companies and businesses with budgets below $2.5M CLP seeking fast, packaged websites in Chile, ENIX Studio routes clients to its sister product **WebBase by NOVVOR** (https://www.webbase.cl).

## Core Capabilities & Services
1. **Strategic Advisory & Commercial Modeling (Consultoría Estratégica)**:
   - Enterprise B2B value proposition structuring.
   - Narrative engineering for private procurement, RFPs, and corporate tenders.
   - Market perception gap diagnosis and digital transformation advisory.
2. **Brand Direction & Perception Engineering (Dirección de Arte & Marca)**:
   - World-class editorial brand identity systems.
   - High-end corporate typography, design systems, and institutional art direction.
   - Perceived value optimization for C-Suite, board members, and institutional investors.
3. **Enterprise Digital Platforms & Bespoke Software (Plataformas & Software a Medida)**:
   - Ultra-fast bespoke corporate platforms engineered with Astro, React, TypeScript, and modern headless architectures.
   - Interactive 3D web showrooms, architectural configurators, and private client portals.
   - Enterprise-grade cybersecurity, ISO/HIPAA compliant data architectures.
4. **Industrial Design, Machine HMI & IoT Telemetry (Powered by NOVVOR)**:
   - Physical industrial product design and rugged equipment CAD modeling.
   - Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI) for heavy mining, manufacturing machinery, and industrial plants.
   - IoT sensor integration, real-time telemetry dashboards, and applied AI automation.

## Representative Case Studies & Impact
- **Altair Industrial Systems** (Mining & Heavy Industry): Commercial restructuring, high-security corporate portal, and NOVVOR HMI telemetry design. Resulted in +$4.8M USD in awarded public/private tenders and 50% shorter B2B sales cycles.
- **Kronos Capital & Residences** (Real Estate & Private Equity): Luxury branding, interactive 3D digital showroom, and investor deal-room. Enabled +$18M USD in pre-launch sales and 70% direct institutional capitalization.
- **Valen Medical Institutes** (High-Complexity Healthcare): Precision patient experience, intelligent AI triage intake, and HIPAA/ISO-compliant privacy infrastructure. Delivered 3.4x increase in surgical admissions.
